allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($response.StatusCode -eq 200\) { Write-Output "Web server is running successfully" } else { Write-Output "Server returned status: $\($response.StatusCode\)" })
PowerShell($resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/data/tables" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $data | Select-Object -ExpandProperty name | Sort-Object)

PowerShell($resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/data/tables" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output "Total tables returned: $\($data.Count\)"; Write-Output "Sample:"; $data[0..2] | ConvertTo-Json)

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/data/tables" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $categories = @{}; $data | ForEach-Object { if \(-not $categories.ContainsKey\($_.category\)\) { $categories[$_.category] = 0 }; $categories[$_.category] += 1 }; $categories | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "$\($_.Name\): $\($_.Value\) tables" })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/data/tables" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output "Total: $\($data.Count\)"; Write-Output "drv_cat: $\(\($data | Where-Object { $_.category -eq 'drv_cat' }\).Count\)"; $data | Where-Object { $_.category -eq 'drv_cat' } | Select-Object name | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "  $\($_.name\)" })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/debug/tables-dict" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output "Total in dict: $\($data.total\)"; Write-Output "drv_cat_count: $\($data.drv_cat_count\)"; Write-Output "First 5 all_tables:"; $data.all_tables[0..4] | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "  $_" })

PowerShell($resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/data/tables" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output "Total tables returned: $\($data.Count\)"; Write-Output "`nBreakdown by category:"; $data | Group-Object category | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "  $\($_.Name\): $\($_.Count\)" }; Write-Output "`nDrv_cat tables present: $\(\($data | Where-Object { $_.category -eq 'drv_cat' }\).Count\)")

PowerShell($resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/data/tables" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $resp.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output "Total tables: $\($data.Count\)"; $data | Group-Object category | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "$\($_.Name\): $\($_.Count\)" })
